text:
Maria (CS): Hey team — HelioHealth wants a 90m interactive enablement session + hands-on migration lab next week. Need to lock slot and facilitators. :calendar:
AJ (Product): ETA on number of seats? are they bringing multiple accounts or a single prod account?
Nate_CSM: They said up to 8 engineers across 3 teams (data, platform, app). Multi-account, will need account scoping in prep.
Maria (CS): Ok — propose two slots: Tue 10:00–11:30 PT (18:00–19:30 UTC) or Thu 13:00–14:30 PT. Which works? :thinking_face:
Leo - Enablement: Tue looks better for facilitators here. Thu conflicts with a roadmap offsite. :raised_hand:
Sam_Support: I can cover Thu if we absolutely have to, but need a heads-up on required access: SSH jump host + temp API key for import flow.
Maria (CS): Good call. We'll aim for Tue then. Agenda draft: 1) 15m recap + success criteria, 2) 25m migration walkthrough (demo), 3) 30m guided hands-on (lab), 4) 20m Q/A + next steps. Need a slide deck + pre-read.
AJ (Product): I'll drop a concise pre-read (1 pager) summarizing migration steps and rollback plan. Link in #docs when ready.
Nate_CSM: Also, capture renewal-risk flags during session — please ping me anytime there are doubts on timelines or scope creep so I can surface to the account lead.
Leo - Enablement: Who's running breakout support during the hands-on? We should have 2 facilitators + 1 floater for env issues.
Maria (CS): Volunteers? I can co-facilitate the walkthrough, Leo does hands-on. Need one more floater.
Sam_Support: I can be the floater for infra access and keys. Will prep a small runbook with the necessary commands:
```
# temp key create (internal)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"migration","ttl":"4h"}'
```
Sam_Support: Will also make a disposable user for HelioHealth and share in a secure note.
AJ (Product): Quick ask — can we timebox the guided lab steps to avoid overrun? Suggest split lab into two checkpoints (15min each) with clear acceptance checks.
Maria (CS): Agreed. We'll add acceptance checks to the pre-read. Nate, do you want a quick sync with customer before the session to confirm goals?
Nate_CSM: Yes — 15m call tomorrow EOD should do. I'll schedule.
CalendarBot: Event created: HelioHealth — Interactive Enablement Lab — Tue 10:00 PT (Zoom link + calendar invites sent). :white_check_mark:
Leo - Enablement: One more thing — HelioHealth mentioned potential interest in Dedicated deployment. Can we have a 5–10m brief on cost/SLAs at the end? Might be useful for renewal signal capture.
Maria (CS): Good idea. Add 8m for "next steps & options" after Q/A.
Sam_Support: I'll prepare the infra checklist and ensure the sandbox is provisioned by Monday EOD.
Nate_CSM: Thanks team — I'll share the customer prep checklist and confirm the attendee list. Also flagging: customer indicated a potential delay in procurement which could affect renewal timeline. I'll raise in my weekly with Sales.
AJ (Product): Sending pre-read and slide stub by EOD.
Maria (CS): Perfect. If anyone can't make Tue facilitation, please speak up now. Otherwise we'll proceed and I'll post final agenda + invite notes in #customer-success. :thumbsup:
